sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If
you invest in our securities in this offering, your interest will be diluted immediately to the extent of the difference between the
price per ordinary share that you pay in this offering and the adjusted net tangible book value per ordinary share of our ordinary shares
immediately after this offering. Our net tangible book value
on June 30, 2026, was approximately $40.7 million, or $0.32 per ordinary share. “Net tangible book value” represents the amount
of our total consolidated tangible assets, less the amount of our total consolidated liabilities. “Net tangible book value per ordinary
share” is net tangible book value divided by the total number of shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026. After giving effect to the
